title: The power of division: thought, speech and the root of the letters

lectures.id: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

overview: This chapter asks where the power to divide a thought into letters and words comes from. Thought has three levels: the image of a thing, the division of that image into letters, which is *dibur* of *machshava*, and logical thinking that organizes an idea into words in a sequence. The power of division is traced to the five *gevuros* of *mem-nun-tzadi-pei-chaf* of *Imma*, the letters whose final forms mark ends and boundaries. Abstract understanding has no words yet. Putting an idea into words is a *tzimtzum*: we choose a few key features, as a caricature or a signet ring does. A child tells good from bad before he can speak, but he has no letters in thought until he learns to speak. Speech is rooted in *chachma* and thought in *bina*, and although *chachma* comes first, thought comes first in revelation, as the *Zohar*'s image of the mother lending her clothes to her daughter shows. The flow of speech is subconscious *chachma*. The chapter closes with the soul's root: thought, speech and action are fixed in the essence of the soul, and what is higher in its root is revealed later.

terms.gloss: thought; the three levels of it are the image, its division into letters, and logical thinking
speech; the letters of thought as they are spoken
the five gevuros in the letters mem, nun, tzadi, pei, chaf, which take a different form at the end of a word and stand for ends and divisions
the mother: binah, the source of the letters of thought (not in the table; defined here)
contraction: choosing a few features and leaving the rest out
wisdom; the first flash of an idea, and the root of speech
understanding; grasping and developing an idea, and the root of thought
lit. father; chachma as a partzuf, which founds the daughter (speech)
the speaking spirit: the letters of speech, the superior soul man was given (not in the table; defined here)
the speaking soul: the intellectual soul, called speaking because its depth shows when it speaks
thought and speech in Zeir Anpin, as the Etz Chaim describes
the subconscious power of thought, the inner depth of chachma: the earlier understanding (his term, not translated)

sections.title: The question: where the power of division comes from
sections.summary: A thought is divided into letters and words by a power. The chapter asks where that power comes from, and sets out the three levels of thought.

phrases.en: chapter 42

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: ומעתה יובן בענין שרש כח המחלק לצירופי אותיות דמחשבה
במדריגה הג', כשחושב ענין דבר מה בצירופים שונים,
phrases.en: when you actually are thinking *machshava iyunis*, when a person is actually thinking about a logical process, they organize the idea into a whole bunch of words, and string them together in a certain order.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: מאין הוא בא כח ההתחלקות זאת
phrases.en: So where does that come from, that idea of dividing it up the way that it's divided?

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The chapter continues the roots of the letters of *machshava* and *dibur*. Its question is the power of division: what lets us divide a thought into words?

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Three levels of *machshava*: imagining the image of a thing; dividing it into letters, which is *dibur* of *machshava*, where symbols or words are made; and *machshava iyunis*, where a logical process organizes the idea into many words in order.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The question, then, is where that division comes from, and what makes the decision to divide the idea in this particular way.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: So it's known from different places, from the *Etz Chaim* and things like that

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: דבחינת ה׳ גבורות מנצפ"ך דאימא הוא שרש כח ההתחלקות הזאת כו'.
phrases.en: that it comes from the

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The root of this power of division is the five *gevuros* of *Imma*, the letters *mem, nun, tzadi, pei, chaf*, as the *Etz Chaim* and other places show.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: These five letters take a different form at the end of a word. They stand for making ends, divisions and boundaries: the idea of *hitchalkus*, division.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is the topic the chapter sets out to explain: how the power of division comes from the five *gevuros* of *Imma*, and what that means.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: Depth, contraction and the signet ring
sections.summary: Abstract thought has no words yet. Putting an idea into words is a contraction: choosing a few key features, as a caricature or a signet ring does. The five gevuros of Imma are the source of that power of division.

phrases.en: so now to explain this topic

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: it's known

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: we know that the idea of *Imma* is the idea of *bina*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: והשגה לאורך ורוחב בהסבר דבר המושכל
phrases.en: That's the idea of understanding a concept with the length and the width of the explanation, a whole logical explanation of an idea

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: *Imma* is *bina*: understanding a concept with its length and breadth, a whole logical explanation of an idea. Now the chapter shows how the power of division comes from *Imma*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: וכאשר הוא מעיין בבחינת העומק של ההשגה,
phrases.en: when a person is looking into the depth of the idea

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: עדיין הוא רק בעומק מחשבה עיונית
phrases.en: So at that point, which is the depth of *machshava iyunis*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שלמעלה מהיות בחינת התחלקות צירופי אותיות ממש
phrases.en: This is higher than being divided into actual words

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: they don't have words yet in their thought to express the concept

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: they only have this intellectual thought, which is still pre-verbal

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: like we see tangibly

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Looking into the depth of an idea is still the depth of the abstract thinking described above. Once an idea is in its length and breadth there are distinctions; in its depth it is abstract, with no models or words yet, only intellectual thought that is not divided into letters.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: Finding the words for a feeling
blocks.text: Ask someone to describe an experience or a feeling. They look inside and search for words: how can I make you understand? That search is the same process, at the level of depth.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: A distinction in a halacha
blocks.text: A person learning a *halacha* in the Gemara senses that one case differs from another, but has no words for the difference. They look at the idea and try to find how to categorize and describe it. This is the depth before the letters.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אך על ידי בחינת ה׳ גבורות,
phrases.en: through this process which is called

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת הצמצום והסתלקות שבכח ההשגה עצמה,
phrases.en: which is the idea of contracting and focusing, and removing the central power of understanding itself

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: להיות יורד אור השכלת הענין שבמחשבה עיונית הנזכר לעיל לבחינת התחלקות צירופים שונים בפרטי פרטיות
phrases.en: In order for this intellectual light, this experience of the idea that is in the thought, to descend into these letters and labels in these different specific ways

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The five *gevuros* are contraction and withdrawal in the power of understanding itself. The essential experience is put into symbols that are always smaller than the idea. That contraction is the power of division.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The caricature
blocks.text: A caricature draws the main features, an eye and a nose, and leaves out the detail. Words and labels work the same way: we choose the important features and ignore the rest. That is unavoidable, since no idea's full richness can be captured.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So a person must choose what to focus on and what to remove. Describing what we saw, we leave out almost all of it and keep a few key features; describing every leaf and blade of grass would be impossible. How do we know which features are the key ones? That is the power of division.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So the light of the idea, descending into separate letters and words, requires that most of the idea be removed and only the words left.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: והוא הנקרא בחינת ה׳ גבורות מנצפ"ך דאימא,
phrases.en: this power, to do that

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: And this is called the signet ring

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The power to do this is to set everything aside and sum it up in a few words or points that capture the essence and set the guidelines.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: Codifying the law
blocks.text: The codes of Torah law, the *Shulchan Aruch* or the Mishna, cannot write every case. They set out the key distinctions that serve as guideposts. A *rav* still needs depth to fill the gaps, but a well-codified set gives the key details needed to understand the whole.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The signet ring
blocks.text: This is the power of *mem-nun-tzadi-pei-chaf* of *Imma*: choosing which features to bring out. A signet ring is engraved so that some features stand out and others sink in; pressed into wax, it makes a form that a printing press can copy. Physically, you must be limited and leave a form, and that form can represent ideas.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Intellectually it is the same. You remove most of the idea, leave a few key ideas and give them names, labels and symbols, and then they can represent the idea.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: ואף על פי שלכאורה בחינת ירידה וצמצום הוא,
phrases.en: And even though seemingly this is a process of descent and *tzimtzum*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אבל שרשו בא מלמעלה מכח ההשגה שבגוף המושכל הזה כו'
phrases.en: But on the other hand, the ability to do that, to take an idea and limit it and choose just the key features to put it into words and create that model, create that framework, actually comes from a higher, deeper level of understanding that's really the depth of the power of understanding more than the experience of the idea itself

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Putting an idea into words is very difficult, and seems to be a descent and a *tzimtzum*. In letters printed in *Tanya* and *Igeres HaKodesh*, the Alter Rebbe explains subtle concepts of *Chassidus* to people who challenged them.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The Alter Rebbe defends the meaning of what is written in the *Tzava'as HaRivash*. It is written as if it were the ethical will of the *Baal Shem Tov*, but he says it is really just a collection of teachings, a legacy of the *Baal Shem Tov*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

sensitivity.reason: An authorship claim stated as fact in his own words: that the Tzava'as HaRivash is really only a collection of the Baal Shem Tov's teachings, not the ethical will it is written as. A reader may take it as a historical claim.
sensitivity.publishable: The Alter Rebbe defends the meaning of what is written in the *Tzava'as HaRivash*. It is written as if it were the ethical will of the *Baal Shem Tov*.
sensitivity.judgmentNote: Whether to print his claim that the text is only a collection of the Baal Shem Tov's teachings. The teaching does not depend on it, and the publishable text drops it.

blocks.text: In some letters, after explaining a concept, the Alter Rebbe says that it is very difficult to put in writing, and that if you come in person, you can discuss it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The Arizal's dream
blocks.text: The Arizal had a dream and experienced something, and told his students that explaining what he had just experienced would take, I think, eighty years.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Putting something into words is a big *tzimtzum*, and an idea can be hard to capture in words. Still, the root of that ability is higher: it comes from a deeper understanding than the experience of the idea itself.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This was discussed earlier with the idea of *Yosef* and of someone who can give *meshalim*. Whenever there is this relationship, bringing something down requires a deeper level, the power of *tevuna*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: The child: understanding before words
sections.summary: A small child recognizes differences before he can speak, but has no letters in thought until he learns to speak. Speech gives thought the clarity it lacks.

phrases.en: so what's the proof for this, that it's really coming from a deeper place?

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: ממה שאנו רואים בתינוק קטן שאין בו עדיין צירופי אותיות במחשבתו בדבר פרטי
phrases.en: that we see, that a small child doesn't yet have this power to have language and and organize their thoughts in this way,

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The proof that this comes from a deeper place is what we see in a small child, who does not yet have letters of thought for a particular thing.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: for example if you give him something

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: even though he knows the difference between one thing and the other

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: he won't let you exchange it for something else

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: that's a distinction, a division within *machshava*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אבל לא בצירופי אותיות כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: but it's not in letters, it's not in words, in other words

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The child who will not be swapped
blocks.text: A small child knows the difference between things. Offer him food he does not like and he pushes it away; if he wants his mother, he will not take someone else. He grasps one thing and another, though not in words.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That recognition of difference is a division within *machshava*, but not the division into letters described above. The child is too young for language, so something is missing from his ability to understand it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Much of what we know becomes clearer only when we articulate it and build a system. We already have *emuna* and faith in G-d; learning about it helps us crystallize what we experience in our faith.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: הנה מכל מקום כאשר יכול לדבר
phrases.en: but when the child is a little bit older and they're able to speak

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and to request a specific thing that they want

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: הרי אז יש לו בודאי במוח מחשבתו צירופי אותיות פרטיים לאותו דבר
phrases.en: So then we know that the child has also in their thought they've created a label and they can identify that thing

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Once a child can speak and asks for a particular thing, we know he has in his mind a label for that particular thing, and can identify it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Younger children may know an object only while it is in front of them, and cannot call it up in their minds without it. Finding words for feelings gives clarity, to others and to ourselves, and those words help us make distinctions.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: כי צירופי אותיות מתחלקות במחשבה תחלה טרם בואם לדבור
phrases.en: because the division, these distinctions, first have to happen in thought before we can speak them

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: (כמו שיתבאר דעקבי לאה נכנסין תוך ראש רחל, דהיינו דבור שבמחשבה הנזכר לעיל שנעשה מחשבה לדבור כו')

blocks.text: The divisions of letters happen first in thought, before we speak. Before we can use words like red and blue effectively, we first have to understand the difference between them in thought.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is a paradox. Thought comes before speech, yet it is speech that gives thought its power: learning to speak requires creating these labels in thought first, and a label must be understood in thought before it can be spoken.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The *Etz Chaim* has Zeir Anpin with two *partzufim*, Leah and Rachel. Leah is thought, related to *chesed*, *gevura* and the top of *tiferes*. Rachel is speech, related to the bottom two-thirds of *tiferes*; they share the middle. Leah's *malchus* goes into Rachel's *keser*. So through the distinctions of thought I can describe and speak.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The writer who studies the subject
blocks.text: Someone who was a writer was told that to write it is more important to study the subject than to study writing, because clarity of thought tells you what you want to say. Someone could study writing and still have nothing to say. Still, learning about writing or speaking has its benefit.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: Speech and the voice of the Torah
sections.summary: The divisions of letters happen first in thought, and speech gives them power. Leah is thought and Rachel is speech, and the voice of the Torah is revealed in the physical world.

phrases.en: as is explained elsewhere

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: about the teaching in the *Zohar*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: על פסוק וקול התור נשמע בארצינו,

phrases.en: that when it comes out, in other words, when we experience g-dliness in the physical world

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אז זמן התחלקות אותיות המחשבה כו'
phrases.en: then we can understand it

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The *Zohar*, on the verse 'the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land' from *Shir HaShirim*, explains that everything G-d created was created for man, and that the voice of the *tor* is the Torah, the voice of G-d, revealed specifically to people.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Here the author says the real essence of the Torah, the voice of G-d, is specifically at the level of speech, in our land. When it comes out, and we experience G-dliness in the physical world, the letters of thought divide and we can understand it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is the idea of *naaseh* before *nishma*. Through the garments of doing Torah and *mitzvos*, and the G-dly experiences they bring, we find G-dliness within ourselves. The Jewish soul comes from *machshava*, and Torah and *mitzvos* in the outer world from *dibur*; creation too helps us appreciate G-dliness.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The same holds for Torah: a person without life experience will not understand Torah either. There are many ways this relationship shows itself.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and this is the general idea

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: that it says in the *Zohar*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: דאימא אוזיפת דרך שאלה ה׳ גבורות מנצפ"ך לברתא, שהוא צירופי התחלקות אותיות הדבור
phrases.en: the mother lends her clothes to her daughter, that the *gevuros* of *mem-nun-tzadi-pei-chaf* are called the clothes of the mother, of *bina*, and they're lent to the daughter, which is *malchus*, which is the idea of *dibur*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The *Zohar*'s teaching is that the mother lends her clothes to her daughter. The five *gevuros* of *mem-nun-tzadi-pei-chaf* are the clothes of the mother, *bina*, lent to the daughter, *malchus*, which is the idea of speech.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: First you create these divisions and labels in thought, and then use them in speech. Yet you create them only for speech, and that is what sharpens thought.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is also why the Rebbe takes every idea in *Chassidus* and shows where it appears in *nigleh*, in Torah law and practice. Without a practical, physical experience of it you lack the sharpness of understanding, and your words and labels mean nothing.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: ואם כן מזה ראיה שאין הצירופים שרשם בהשגה עצמה
phrases.en: So from here, we have a proof that the choice of the letters and the words doesn't come from the understanding itself.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So from this there is a proof that the choice of letters and words does not come from the understanding itself.

phrases.en: these words and the labels

phrases.he: עד שיכול לדבר דוקא כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: until the child learns to speak, and only when they learn to speak do they have these distinctions in their thoughts as well

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: A small child already tells good from bad, and what he likes, before he can speak, yet he has no letters in his thought. Recognizing a difference does not give you the power to put it into words.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Why? There is a second step: creating words, models and labels. Animals and small children have an understanding that is still immature. When you learn to speak you gain what is called metacognition: you can think about your thoughts, be aware of yourself, and organize them in a far superior way.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אלא שרשם מלמעלה מן ההשגה דבינה,
phrases.en: comes from beyond, higher than the understanding of *bina*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: והוא מבחינת כח ומקור של כל עומק ההשגה כו'
phrases.en: It really comes from the real source of the whole depth of the understanding, from the real essence of the *omek* that's higher than the revealed understanding

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That ability comes from a level beyond the understanding of *bina*: from the real source of the whole depth of understanding, from an essence higher than revealed understanding.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: Chachma and the subconscious flow
sections.summary: The power that puts words together is a flow that comes from chachma, the subconscious root of understanding, and it is higher than the intellectual process itself.

phrases.he: (כמו שבאותיות הדבור שרש כח הצירופים מאבא,
phrases.en: just like the power of speech comes from the source of *chachma*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שהוא כח המשכיל דחכמה שנקרא קדמות השכל
phrases.en: which is the subconscious power of thought

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The power of speech comes from *Abba*, the inner part of *chachma*: the power that understands, which is called the *kadmus hasechel*, the earlier understanding.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: Speech that has become second nature
blocks.text: As *Tanya* says, when we speak we do not consciously think how to move the lips and throat. We know how, subconsciously. So with anything we master, like speaking fluently or riding a bike: it becomes transparent.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That is the inner, subconscious depth of *chachma*. Likewise, we take our experiences, choose what to focus on, filter them and label what is important. G-d put this process into us, before our conscious understanding.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: (כמו שכתוב במקום אחר בענין תרין ציפרין כמו שיתבאר בעזרת השם)
phrases.en: like it explains elsewhere about the these two birds, and like we will explain with help of G-d

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is explained elsewhere, in the matter of the two birds, and it will be explained with the help of G-d.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: ואף על פי שה׳ גבורות מנצפ"ך שבה' מוצאות
phrases.en: even though these *gevuros* correspond to the five organs of speech, the throat, the tongue, the teeth, the palate and the lips

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: what's dividing up the words of speech

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: כפי אופן התחלקות צירופים שבמחשבה, ממש
phrases.en: so those divisions of that are causing us to be able to articulate the words is coming from the fact that we have these distinctions in thought

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: nevertheless

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: it says that *Abba* founds the daughter, the father founds the daughter

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Even though the five *gevuros* of *mem-nun-tzadi-pei-chaf* correspond to the five organs of speech, and divide and arrange the words of speech, nevertheless *Abba* founded the daughter. So the real source is the level of thought from *chachma*, which is higher than the logic and understanding of *bina*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: which is the power to put together

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: בלתי כוונה בשכל והשגה איך לצרף,
phrases.en: that you're not consciously thinking how do I put together the sounds to make the words

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: it just happens and it just flows

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: like it says that *chachma* puts things together

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: we're going to talk about this later

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The power of putting words together is not a conscious calculation of how to join sounds. It just comes and flows. That flow state, which we are not consciously aware of, shows that it comes from the *kadmus hasechel*, the inner subconscious ability to understand.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: there's a similar relationship

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: the same thing with selecting our words that happens in thought

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The same relationship holds for selecting words in thought. Just as speaking is subconscious, choosing words in thought is what *chachma* does, and it flows automatically, like a person who knows an instrument so well that he does not have to think what to do.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: ונמצא שגם שבחינת הצירופים עצמם שבמחשבה על ידי בחינת צמצום דמחשבה עיונית הוא בא,
phrases.en: even though the words themselves in thoughts are coming through a *tzimtzum* to *machshava iyunis*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: מכל מקום כח ושרש העושה לצירוף והתחלקות זאת,
phrases.en: but the power that's making this decision of which words to choose

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: הרי הוא למעלה מכח ההשגה שבמחשבה עיונית עצמה כו'
phrases.en: that's higher than the intellectual process itself

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Even though the words in thought come through a *tzimtzum* to intellectual thought, the power that chooses the few parts to put into words, and makes this division, is higher than the intellectual process itself.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שלזה הטעם אין התינוק יכול לצרף אותיות מחשבתו
phrases.en: and this is why a child can understand something, but they can't put it into words

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: until they have the ability to speak

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: גם שמשיג ומבחין היטב בגוף הענין דבר מה
phrases.en: even though they understand, they recognize the differences between things

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: A child can understand something, yet cannot put his thoughts into letters until he can speak. Creating words is a symbolic representation, one thing standing for another. Seeing a connection between two things that are not really related comes from a higher, deeper power: the inner part of *chachma* or *bina*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: Why thought comes before speech
sections.summary: Speech is rooted in chachma and thought in binah. Chachma comes before binah, so speech should come first; yet thought comes first, because the thought of binah sets the content that speech says.

phrases.he: ואם כן הרי מה שאמרו דקטן אין לו מחשבה,
phrases.en: we say that a child doesn't have thought

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: היינו בבחינת צרופי אותיות המחשבה דוקא,
phrases.en: what we mean they don't have this superior type of thought that comes with language

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: לפי ששרשם בא מכח ומקור של המחשבה דהשגה דבינה
phrases.en: because this type of thought comes from the inner source and root of the thought of *machshava bina*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: We say a child has no thought: a halachic matter, since for laws such as *tumah* and *muktzeh* the status of a thing depends on intention, which a child does not yet have. What we mean is that he lacks the superior thought that comes with language.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This thought comes from the inner source and root of *machshava* and of *bina*, which is deeper than the ability to recognize differences that a small child has.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: So this is from the one of the things that are wondrous and hidden

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: why does thought come before speech?

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: הרי הדבור שרשו בפנימיות ומקור החכמה והמחשבה שרשה בפנימית ומקור דבינה, והחכמה קדמה לבינה
phrases.en: the source of speech is in *chachma*, or really the source of *chachma*, and thought is coming its root is in the source and root of *bina*, and *chachma* comes before *bina*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שהחכמה נקרא אין ובינה יש כו'
phrases.en: because *chachma* is called an *ein*, is something that's abstract, and *bina* is called a *yesh*, is something concrete

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Why does thought come before speech? It is one of the wondrous hidden things: what goes lower comes from something higher. Speech is rooted in *chachma* and thought in *bina*, and *chachma* comes before *bina*: *chachma* is *ein*, *bina* is *yesh*, so speech would seem to come first. The reason is that speech comes from *chachma*, the ability to make something transparent and flowing, while *bina* is conscious awareness and systematizing.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: (וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר בענין דבר ואמרת,
phrases.en: that there's these two idea of speaking and *amarta*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שהדבור גבוה בשרשו מאמירה דמחשבה כו'
phrases.en: speech is higher in its source than *amirah*, which is the idea of talking to oneself in thought

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: As is explained elsewhere: *amar* can mean to speak and also to think. Speaking, it is explaining your thoughts; *dibur* is a proclamation, or saying something without discussion. *Dibur* is higher in its source than *amirah*, talking to oneself in thought.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and we see this because, again,

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שאין המחשבה באה בהתחלקות צרופים כי אם
phrases.en: you only have the power to really think clearly

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: once you can speak

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: We see this too: thought only develops the power to think clearly once speech develops in the child.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: on the one hand, the power of thinking really depends on the power of speech, but on the other hand

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: the content of what you're going to speak has to first come through the *gevuros*, the *mem-nun-tzadi-pei-chaf* of *bina*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: דוקא שרש לה׳ גבורות התחלקות דדבור,
phrases.en: and that's going to give the content to speech, so of what it's going to say

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: like it says, like mother like daughter

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: On the one hand, thought depends on speech. On the other hand, what you are going to say must first come through the five *gevuros* of *bina*, which give speech its content. As it says, like mother, like daughter: it goes from *bina*, thought, first, and then to speech.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: but on the other hand, in their source,

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: *dibur* is in *chachma*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: ולכך אבא דוקא יסד ברתא כו'
phrases.en: and therefore the *chachma* is really the source of speech, not *bina*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: In their source, however, speech is in *chachma*, and that is why *Abba* specifically founded the daughter. So the real source of speech is *chachma*, not *bina*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: The soul's root: what is higher comes out last
sections.summary: Thought, speech and action are fixed in the essence of the soul. What is higher in its root is revealed later, and the speaking soul is revealed only when the soul speaks.

phrases.he: וגם מצד שרש הראשון דמחשבה דבור
phrases.en: and also when you look to the original root of thought and speech

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: כמו שהם קבועים בעצם הנפש הנזכר לעיל,
phrases.en: like we spoke before how the source of the letters of both *machshava* and *dibur* go all the way back to the essence of the soul

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: we spoke about that in chapter 37

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: there we spoke about the three levels

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: הרי גם שם כלול תחלה אותיות המחשבה בעצם הנפש טרם שכלולה מאותיות הדבור
phrases.en: So also in the source, the soul first has the letters of thought before it has the letters of speech

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Look at the root of thought, speech and action as they are fixed in the essence of the soul: the letters of thought are in the soul's essence before the letters of speech, which are called *ruach memalel*. We spoke of this in chapter 37, where the three levels are set out: the thought, speech and action of thought.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So the soul first has the letters of thought, to define each level: what thought, feeling or idea I have, and what I want, in the *ratzon*. Then one thing can be *mitlabesh* in another: *sechel* in *ratzon*, the *middos* in *sechel*. That is *dibur*. Thought is more central and comes first.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The letters of speech are called *ruach memalel*, the speaking spirit, the superior soul that man was given.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: דכמו שבנפש שבאה בגוף קדם המחשבה לדבור ב' שנים,
phrases.en: just like when the soul comes into the body, that the person has the power to think before they can speak for about two years

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: so too in the spiritual soul, the way it is higher than the body

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: לא נקרא רוח ממללא זמן מה
phrases.en: at first it's a soul, but it's not yet called a *ruach memalel*, a speaking soul

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: כו' והמחשבה כבר יש בה כו'
phrases.en: but it already has *machshava*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Just as a child thinks for about two years before he can speak, so too the spiritual soul is not called *ruach memalel* for a time, yet it already has *machshava*. The soul has a certain nature and a G-dly thing of *emuna* and understanding, but it requires a deeper power to express its essential nature in something lower, in the body and the physical world. That is a deeper power.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is why we learn. We start at the level of *igulim*, knowing inside who we are but not what that means outside ourselves. Learning and practice match the inner self with the outer world, and in doing so we discover who we are in a deeper way.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: This is a *yerida* for the sake of an *aliyah*: coming down into the body and the world, and expressing ideas in speech and our *emuna* in Torah and *mitzvos*, reveals the essence of the soul more deeply, and the real strength of our *emuna*. When we externalize things we gain clarity inside too.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and the reason that this is so is only because

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שכל דבר הגבוה בשרשו בעצמיות יותר
phrases.en: that when something is higher in its root and essence

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: then it is revealed later

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and that's why the humans soul, the uniqueness of the human soul is that we're called speaking man

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: in other words, the true intellectual soul that we have is called the speaking soul

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: so this is the essential *chachma*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שהוא קודם למחשבה העצמיות שבה כו'
phrases.en: which precedes within the soul the essential *machshava* in the soul

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The reason is only that when something is higher in its root and essence, it comes out later, in revelation.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That is why the human soul is called specifically the *nefesh hamedabreis*, the speaking soul, the intellectual soul. Only when we can speak does its depth of understanding come out, beyond an animal's: language, art, expressing the spiritual in the physical, symbols, and seeing connections between things that are not really connected.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So this is the essential *chachma*, which comes before the essential *machshava* in the soul. The power of speech comes from it: deeper in essence, but revealed later.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אבל בגלוי בא באחרונה דוקא, מטעם המבואר במקום אחר באריכות ודי למבין)
phrases.en: but in revelation it comes specifically afterwards, for the reason explained elsewhere at length, and this is enough to understand

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: In revelation it comes last, for a reason explained elsewhere at length. This is enough for one who understands.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The lesson for practice
blocks.text: This is the *nimshal*: physical experience matters, and *maaseh* is the main thing. Bringing the soul's power into the physical *taryag mitzvos* draws out something deeper, and going out into the physical world and body, which cover the soul, forces us to reach deeper. Learning in *Chassidus* means finding it in *nigleh* too.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/042 Shaar HaYichud ch 42 enhanced.mp3

reviewQuestions.question: What are the three levels of thought, and where does the power to divide a thought into words come from?
Why is putting an idea into words a tzimtzum, and what do the caricature and the signet ring show about it?
Why can a small child tell good from bad, and still have no letters in his thought?
Why does thought come before speech, when chachma comes before binah?
Why is the essential chachma of the soul revealed only later?

notes.text: Line 1: the Hebrew for "and now it will be understood, the roots of the letters of machshava" has no English of its own. The English before the reading (the roots of the letters of machshava and dibur) is an overview and is in the first block.
Line 3: the phrase on "binah" is his English for the first part of the cut ("we know that the idea of Imma is the idea of binah"); the "length and width" clause is the next phrase.
Line 7: the first phrase now ends on the English word 'tzimtzum', which he says in English. The Arizal's dream: he says "I think it was 80 years"; the hedge is kept in the block.

Line 7, flag: his claim that the Tzava'as HaRivash is only a collection of the Baal Shem Tov's teachings is a claim about authorship, stated as fact. The block reports it as his claim ("he says"). The flag is recommend judgment: the publishable text drops the claim, and a person may decide to print it as said.

Line 9: 'that's a distinction, a division within' is his English for the Hebrew 'the division of machshava'. The phrase now runs to the word machshava, which he says in his English ("a division within machshava").

Phrases on lines 10, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 28, 29, 30, 31 and 32 were checked against the audio and re-cut where an English clause rendered only part of a Hebrew cut, or where his English for a Hebrew piece had been left out. Where a line's English is a gloss on no Hebrew of the line (for example "so really it's coming from this level of thought" on line 19), it is in the block and not in a phrase.
Line 17: 'kadmus hasechel' is his term and he does not translate it; the block glosses it as 'the earlier understanding' (a literal gloss of the words).
Line 26: 'amarta' is spelled as the transcript has the Hebrew word he says (the verb form); the block uses 'amirah' for the noun, as the chapter does.
Line 30: the parenthesised reference is chapter 37, as he says in English ('we spoke about that in chapter 37'); the block cites that chapter and the three levels as he gives them.
